deeplink_not_found: Issue #{{n}} not found, returned to task list
detail_not_in_results: This issue is not in the current filter results
admin_confirm_done_message: Confirm this requirement as done with repository admin authority? The requirement and its pipeline will be finalized, and an audit log entry will be recorded.
revert_completed_message: Return this completed issue to pending review? Completion info (time/reason) will be cleared, the issue re-enters review and pipeline flow, and the action is audit-logged. The linked VCS issue is NOT reopened.
confirm_done_message: SRE deployment is complete. Confirm this requirement as done?
cancel_task_message: Confirm cancelling this requirement? It can be resumed later.
reopen_task_message: Return this completed requirement to In Progress? Completion time/reason will be cleared and the pipeline will NOT auto-redispatch (re-dispatch manually from the event page to continue). The action is audit-logged; the linked VCS issue is not reopened.

empty.select_task_desc: Select a requirement from the list to view details.

create.scene_hint: If not selected, smart recommend will auto-detect
create.assignee_hint: Creator = current logged-in account, set automatically
